findings.text: SNC off (1 NUMA node per socket) on 2 compute dies (TPMI uncore domains with core agents): SNC2 makes each compute die its own NUMA node with its local memory channels (Intel Xeon 6 SNC guide 845720); up then labels k3d-gpu.io/snc=2 and replica pods get one node each

RDT allocation (rdt_a: cat_l2 cat_l3 cdp_l2 cdp_l3 mba) — resctrl classes are available but left off: the balloons policy ships control.rdt.enable: false because enabling it rewrites the host's /sys/fs/resctrl. To opt in, mount resctrl on the host (mount -t resctrl resctrl /sys/fs/resctrl) and set control.rdt.enable: true in nri-balloons.yml; usePodQoSAsDefaultClass then gives BestEffort/Burstable/Guaranteed pods 33%/66%/100% of the L3. To revert, set control.rdt.enable: false in nri-balloons.yml, then sudo umount /sys/fs/resctrl

noisy-neighbour isolation: rdt-mba — CAT + MBA can cap a neighbour's cache share and DRAM bandwidth through the RDT opt-in above (resctrl mounted: no); the shipped classes set cache shares only, so add mbAllocation: {all: ["50%"]} to the BestEffort class for bandwidth; the classes run inside the NRI balloons policy, which up deploys on hybrid or multi-NUMA hosts only
